title: Governance Decisions as Evidence v1
files_changed: rig_relay/core/governance_runtime.py (MODIFIED — added evidence field and _persist_governance_decision; evidence fail-closed on mutation)
decision_evidence_model_fields: decision: (decision, rationale, gate, governance_decision_id, surface, authority_tier, capability_id, content_light_classification=public_safe)
evidence: [governance_decision schema ref, gate_decision payload SHA256]
persistence_path_chosen: GovernanceDecisionEvidence adapter wrapping ReceiptStore protocol. If FilesystemReceiptStore is wired into GovernanceRuntime via evidence field, every governance decision is persisted as a ReceiptEnvelope to sharded JSON files with manifest.jsonl index. Content-light: no raw prompts, completions, private repo content, secrets, credentials, raw diffs, or raw Actions logs.
fail_closed_behavior: GovernanceRuntime.should_execute_tool() now: (1) classifies mutation tools via _is_likely_mutation_tool(), (2) evaluates via GovernanceEngine.evaluate_action_legality(), (3) persists the GateDecision via _persist_governance_decision(), (4) returns SKIP if persistence failed for mutation operations. Read-only tools are unaffected by evidence absence. Blocked/requires_review decisions return False from should_block_mutation_on_evidence_failure.
tests_run: 46 passed, 0 failed (23 evidence tests + 23 governance spine tests)
test_classifications: 8 unit, 15 contract, 0 integration, 0 E2E, 3 real-artifact, 0 adversarial, 0 sabotage, 0 concurrency, 3 substrate
dependency_changes: None. All dependencies (pydantic, hashlib stdlib, tempfile stdlib for tests) are existing.
telemetry_redaction_implications: All decision evidence is content-light: no raw prompts, completions, private repo content, secrets, credentials, raw diffs, or raw Actions logs. Decision IDs are SHA256-derived. Evidence payload hashes are canonical JSON hashes. Content-light classification is 'public_safe' by default for governance decisions.
frontend_implications: Cockpit can now consume governance decision evidence from ReceiptStore for 'why blocked' explainer. Evidence timeline can show decision_id-linked entries. Requires P1 cockpit integration.
cli_implications: CLI/scripts not directly affected. CLI governance gating requires P1 CLI taxonomy unification.
mcp_implications: MCP tool-call receipts are not yet aligned with common ReceiptEnvelope format. This is the next P1 integration step.
acp_implications: ACP not directly affected. ACP governance integration requires P1 IDE sidecar convergence.
a2a_implications: A2A delegation receipts can now include governance decision evidence. delegation_allowed_by_governance() currently blocks all delegation per authority spine.
ssh_implications: Not affected — SSH absent per authority spine.
hosted_implications: Not affected — hosted mode design phase. Evidence persistence via ReceiptStore and JSONL artifacts establishes the dual-write prerequisite.
github_trust_spine_implications: Governance decisions for GitHub-related mutations are now persisted as evidence. Trust spine pipeline can consume these receipts for audit trail and governance replay.
postgres_source_of_truth_implications: ReceiptStore (JSONL manifest + sharded JSON files) remains the portable source-of-truth. When Postgres adapter is implemented, governance decision evidence can be dual-written to Postgres operational projection.
completed_work: Added build_governance_decision_envelope() to receipt_envelope.py — bridges GateDecision to ReceiptEnvelope
Added evidence field to GovernanceRuntime dataclass
GovernanceRuntime blocks mutation when evidence persistence fails
Created 23 tests verifying decision-to-envelope conversion, filesystem persistence, retrieval, replay, fail-closed behavior, and content-light guarantees
intentionally_deferred_work: MCP tool-call receipts not yet aligned with common ReceiptEnvelope format (P1)
remaining_seams: Governance decisions are persisted per-call but not yet replayed/aggregated for audit — replay pipeline needs ReceiptStore.list_by_session() or similar
No cross-session governance decision correlation (trace_id not yet propagated across calls)
Evidence persistence failure on read-only tools doesn't currently degrade cockpit projections — need staleness indicator
ReceiptEnvelope format not yet adopted by MCP, ACP, or WebSocket surfaces
next_recommended_implementation_slice: P1: Align MCP tool-call receipts with common ReceiptEnvelope format. Adopt ReceiptEnvelope in MCP server for all tool call responses. Ensure content-light classification and decision_id are present on every MCP receipt.
